description: This file defines interfaces, enums, and component functions related to ADB (Android Debug Bridge) configuration within the Cuttlefish project. It declares classes like AdbConfig, AdbConfigFragment, and AdbConfigFlag, as well as functions for converting AdbMode enum values and for assembling dependency injection components using fruit.

classes.name: AdbConfig
classes.description: Abstract interface for ADB configuration, including methods to get/set modes and a connector flag.

classes.name: AdbConfigFragment
classes.description: Placeholder class inheriting from ConfigFragment, used for dependency injection or configuration grouping.

classes.name: AdbConfigFlag
classes.description: Placeholder class inheriting from FlagFeature, used as a feature flag within configuration.

methods.name: StringToAdbMode
methods.description: Converts a string to the corresponding AdbMode enum value.

methods.name: AdbModeToString
methods.description: Converts an AdbMode enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: AdbConfigComponent
methods.description: Creates a fruit dependency injection component providing AdbConfig.

methods.name: AdbConfigFlagComponent
methods.description: Creates a fruit component requiring AdbConfig and ConfigFlag, providing AdbConfigFlag.

methods.name: AdbConfigFragmentComponent
methods.description: Creates a fruit component requiring AdbConfig, AdbConfigFragment, and other dependencies for ADB configuration fragment.

methods.name: LaunchAdbComponent
methods.description: Creates a fruit component requiring several dependencies related to kernel log and configuration, to launch ADB process.
